'''Matt Moss''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[September 2000 Williston Park tournament (9 September)]] on 9 September 2000 with Imperial Command Deck, according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1210">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-williston-park-ny-9-9-00d1210/ williston-park-ny-9-9-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 9 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-williston-park-ny-9-9-00d1210/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
